title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in Kachin, Kayah and Tanintharyi Regions of Myanmar works towards the goal that women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing and meaningful participation and leadership. This objective focuses on increasing their voice and leadership in all spheres. Activities include training women on topics to support their empowerment journeys, resource on business skills, leadership skills and establish community-based women groups where needed. The principal focus of this objective is: - Women’s empowerment and participation in decision making spaces - Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys - Compensate for past discrimination - Support to women’s equality organisations and institutions
